description.zh: 农场主（15 周年纪念版，基础多人规则）的流程定义——一局游戏从 Setup 到终局判胜的完整流程。与 concepts.json 配合：concepts.json 定义「有什么」（对象、行动、触发器、条件），本文档定义「按什么顺序进行」（Setup、14 回合 × 4 阶段、终局流程）。Setup 阶段使用 do_after 表达事件间的依赖关系：无 do_after 的事件互相独立，可任意顺序或并行执行。每局固定 14 个回合，每回合：准备（翻回合卡、水井收入、累积补充）→ 工作（起始玩家顺时针轮流各放 1 人，直到全部放完）→ 回家 → 收获（仅第 4/7/9/11/13/14 回合，田地→喂养→繁殖）。
description.en: Flow definition for Agricola (15th Anniversary Edition, base multiplayer rules) — the complete sequence of a game from setup to endgame adjudication. Complements concepts.json: concepts.json defines 'what exists' (objects, actions, triggers, conditions); this document defines 'in what order it happens' (setup, 14 rounds × 4 phases, endgame). The setup phase uses do_after to express dependencies between events: events without do_after are independent and may execute in any order or in parallel. A game is fixed at 14 rounds; each round: preparation (reveal round card, well income, accumulation refill) → work (starting with the starting player and going clockwise, each player places 1 person at a time until all are placed) → returning home → harvest (only rounds 4/7/9/11/13/14: fields → feeding → breeding).

description.zh: 整局农场主游戏，作为最外层轮。包含设置、14 回合的循环与终局。
description.en: The whole game of Agricola as the outermost round: setup, the 14-round loop, and the endgame.

description.zh: 开局设置：铺版图（按人数装扩展板）、洗职业与次要改良各发 7 张、发放组件与起始食物、整理 14 张回合卡为 6 个阶段牌堆、摆好 10 张主要改良与公共供应、随机决定起始玩家。各步骤之间无依赖的可任意顺序。
description.en: Game setup: lay out the board (attach the extension per player count), shuffle and deal 7 occupations and 7 minor improvements to each player, hand out components and starting food, sort the 14 round cards into 6 stage piles, set out the 10 major improvements and the general supply, and randomly determine the starting player. Steps without dependencies may run in any order.

description.zh: 把<game_board>放中间，按玩家人数装扩展板：2 人局不加；3 人局加<space_lessons_3p>、<space_clay_3p>、<space_wood_3p>；4 人局加<space_reed_stone_food_4p>、<space_travelling_players>、<space_wood_4p>、<space_lessons_4p>、<space_clay_4p>、<space_wood_4p_2>。把<room_tile>/<field_tile>板块堆放版图旁。
description.en: Place the <game_board> in the middle and attach the extension by player count: none with 2 players; <space_lessons_3p>, <space_clay_3p>, and <space_wood_3p> with 3; <space_reed_stone_food_4p>, <space_travelling_players>, <space_wood_4p>, <space_lessons_4p>, <space_clay_4p>, and <space_wood_4p_2> with 4. Put the <room_tile>/<field_tile> stacks beside the board.

description.zh: 先按人数筛选<occupation_card>（左侧方块符号：[1+] 用于 1-4 人、[3+] 用于 3-4 人、[4] 仅 4 人局——不用的放回盒中），把剩下的洗混，每位玩家从牌堆顶抽 7 张入<hand>。
description.en: First filter the <occupation_card>s by player count (the square symbol on the left: [1+] for 1-4 players, [3+] for 3-4, [4] for 4 only — unused cards go back in the box), shuffle the rest, and deal 7 to each player's <hand>.

options.source: 按人数筛选后的职业牌堆

description.zh: 把<minor_improvement_card>洗混，每位玩家抽 7 张入<hand>。之后整局不再抽牌。
description.en: Shuffle the <minor_improvement_card>s and deal 7 to each player's <hand>. No cards are drawn for the rest of the game.

description.zh: 每位玩家拿到自己的<farmyard_board>（左下角预印 2 个木屋房间）与玩家颜色组件：5 个<family_member>（2 个放进木屋房间、3 个放<personal_supply>）、4 个<stable>、15 根<fence>。
description.en: Each player takes their <farmyard_board> (2 wooden rooms pre-printed at the bottom left) and their color's components: 5 <family_member>s (2 into the wooden rooms, 3 into the <personal_supply>), 4 <stable>s, and 15 <fence>s.

description.zh: 把 2 个<family_member>放进<house>的两个木屋房间（每个房间住 1 人）。
description.en: Place 2 <family_member>s into the <house>'s two wooden rooms (one per room).

description.zh: 把剩余 3 个<family_member>、4 个<stable>、15 根<fence>放入<personal_supply>。
description.en: Put the remaining 3 <family_member>s, 4 <stable>s, and 15 <fence>s into the <personal_supply>.

description.zh: 把 14 张<round_card>按背面数字分成 6 堆（第 1 阶段 4 张、第 2 阶段 3 张、第 3 阶段 2 张、第 4 阶段 2 张、第 5 阶段 2 张、第 6 阶段 1 张），各堆内部洗混，按阶段顺序叠成牌堆——每回合翻最上面一张。
description.en: Sort the 14 <round_card>s by the number on their backs into 6 piles (4 in stage 1, 3 in stage 2, 2 in stage 3, 2 in stage 4, 2 in stage 5, 1 in stage 6), shuffle each pile, and stack them in stage order — the top card is revealed each round.

description.zh: 把 10 张<major_improvement_card>全部正面朝上放入<major_improvement_frame>（先到先得）。
description.en: Place all 10 <major_improvement_card>s face up into the <major_improvement_frame> (first come, first served).

description.zh: 把<animal>（18 只羊、15 只野猪、13 头牛）、<building_resource>（38 木头、26 黏土、14 芦苇、16 石头）、<crop>（24 谷物、16 蔬菜）、<food>标记与 7 个<begging_marker>放<general_supply>。
description.en: Place the <animal>s (18 sheep, 15 wild boar, 13 cattle), <building_resource>s (38 wood, 26 clay, 14 reed, 16 stone), <crop>s (24 grain, 16 vegetables), <food> markers, and 7 <begging_marker>s in the <general_supply>.

description.zh: 随机决定<ontology::starting_player>，把<starting_player_token>交给该玩家。之后起始玩家**不会自动轮换**——只有<take_starting_player>能夺取。
description.en: Randomly determine <ontology::starting_player> and hand them the <starting_player_token>. The starting player **never rotates automatically** — only <take_starting_player> claims it.

rules.zh: 随机选一名玩家设为<ontology::starting_player>并持有<starting_player_token>。
rules.en: Pick a random player as <ontology::starting_player>, holding the <starting_player_token>.

description.zh: 起始玩家得 2 <food>、其他玩家各 3 <food>，放入<personal_supply>。
description.en: The starting player gets 2 <food> and each other player 3 <food>, into their <personal_supply>.

quantity.zh: 起始玩家 2 份、其他玩家 3 份。
quantity.en: 2 for the starting player, 3 for each other player.

description.zh: 14 个回合的循环（回合 1-14）。每回合依次：准备（翻回合卡、水井收入、累积补充）→ 工作（起始玩家顺时针轮流各放 1 人直到放完）→ 回家 → 收获（仅第 4/7/9/11/13/14 回合）。第 14 回合收获后进入终局。
description.en: The loop of 14 rounds (1-14). Each round in order: preparation (reveal round card, well income, accumulation refill) → work (starting player first, clockwise, one person at a time until all placed) → returning home → harvest (only rounds 4/7/9/11/13/14). The endgame follows the round-14 harvest.

description.zh: 回合开始：翻开本回合的<round_card>（成为新的行动格）→ 若当前<round_space>上有<well>放的食物则井主获得 → 所有<accumulation_space>补充货物（已有货物不清走、照加）。
description.en: Round start: reveal this round's <round_card> (becoming a new action space) → if the current <round_space> holds food placed by the <well>, its owner collects it → refill every <accumulation_space> (existing goods stay and more are added).

description.zh: 结算<reveal_round_card>：从阶段牌堆顶翻 1 张<round_card>放到当前回合编号的<round_space>上，从此成为新的行动格。
description.en: Resolve <reveal_round_card>: reveal the top <round_card> of the stage pile onto the <round_space> of the current round number; it becomes a new action space.

description.zh: 翻开回合卡并放到对应回合格。
description.en: Reveal the round card onto its round space.

description.zh: 结算<well_income>：若当前<round_space>上有食物，<well>的拥有者获得它。
description.en: Resolve <well_income>: if the current <round_space> holds food, the <well>'s owner receives it.

description.zh: 井主获得当前回合格上的 1 食物。
description.en: The well's owner takes the 1 food on the current round space.

description.zh: 结算<accumulation_refill>：每个<accumulation_space>按标注数量补货——即使上一回合的货物还在也照加。
description.en: Resolve <accumulation_refill>: every <accumulation_space> gains its depicted amount — even if goods remain from previous rounds.

description.zh: 所有累积格按标注补充货物。
description.en: Refill all accumulation spaces by their printed amounts.

description.zh: 本回合的行动轮：从起始玩家开始、顺时针依次，每位玩家每次恰好放 1 个<family_member>到空闲<action_space>并立即结算，直到所有玩家的所有人都放完（没有人的玩家跳过）。每个行动格每回合只能被 1 人使用。
description.en: This round's action phase: starting with the starting player and continuing clockwise, each player places exactly 1 <family_member> on a free <action_space> at a time, resolving it immediately, until every player has placed all their people (players with none left are skipped). Each action space takes only one person per round.

description.zh: 一轮放置：每位还有<family_member>的玩家按当前回合顺序（起始玩家开始、顺时针）各放 1 人。
description.en: One placement cycle: each player who still has <family_member>s places 1 person, in current round order (starting player first, then clockwise).

description.zh: 一位玩家的回合：放 1 个<family_member>到空闲<action_space>并立即结算（<place_family_member>）。没有人的玩家跳过。
description.en: One player's turn: place 1 <family_member> on a free <action_space> and resolve it immediately (<place_family_member>). Players with no people left are skipped.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 该玩家还有未放置的<family_member>——没有人的玩家跳过本轮。
<ontology::condition>.en: The player still has an unplaced <family_member> — players with none left are skipped.

description.zh: 所有<family_member>从版图各<action_space>回到自己的房间（每个房间住 1 人）。本回合家庭成长的新生儿此时进入自己的房间，正式成为家庭成员。若房间不足（无房间成长造成），回家的人仍可住下——之后建新房时其中一人立刻搬进去。
description.en: All <family_member>s return from the board's <action_space>s to their rooms (one person per room). A newborn from this round's family growth enters its own room now, officially becoming a family member. If rooms are short (growth without room), the returning people still move in — when a room is built later, one person moves in immediately.

description.zh: 每位玩家把自己版图上所有<family_member>拿回<house>的房间（新生儿进自己的房间）。
description.en: Each player returns all their <family_member>s from the board's action spaces into the <house>'s rooms (a newborn enters its own room).

description.zh: 仅在<harvest_round>（第 4/7/9/11/13/14 回合）结束时进行。每位玩家依次结算三小阶段：田地（每块田强制取 1 个作物）→ 喂养（每人 2 食物、新生儿 1，不足拿乞讨标记）→ 繁殖（每种 ≥2 只同类得 1 只新生，需能安置）。非收获回合跳过本阶段。
description.en: Only at the end of a <harvest_round> (rounds 4/7/9/11/13/14). Each player resolves three sub-phases: fields (must take 1 crop per field) → feeding (2 food per member, 1 per newborn, begging markers for shortfalls) → breeding (1 newborn per type with ≥2, if accommodable). Skipped in other rounds.

description.zh: 结算<harvest_field_phase>：从自己的每块<field_tile>上取 1 个作物入<personal_supply>（必须取，一块也不能跳过）。
description.en: Resolve <harvest_field_phase>: take 1 crop from every <field_tile> into your <personal_supply> (mandatory, no field may be skipped).

description.zh: 每块田收 1 个作物。
description.en: Take 1 crop per field.

description.zh: 结算<harvest_feeding>：每个已上场<family_member>需 2 <food>、本回合新生儿只需 1；可用生吃、烹饪、手工建筑转换或卡牌效果支付；每缺 1 食物拿 1 个<begging_marker>（-3 分）。
description.en: Resolve <harvest_feeding>: every <family_member> in play needs 2 <food>, a newborn only 1; pay via raw eating, cooking, craft conversions, or card effects; take 1 <begging_marker> (-3 points) per food short.

description.zh: 喂养家人，不足部分拿乞讨标记。
description.en: Feed the family; take begging markers for shortfalls.

description.zh: 结算<harvest_breeding>：每种动物若有 ≥2 只且能安置新生动物，从<general_supply>得 1 只同类新生（每收获每种类至多 1 只）。繁殖阶段禁止烹饪父母或新生动物。
description.en: Resolve <harvest_breeding>: for each animal type with ≥2 and room for a newborn, take 1 of that type from the <general_supply> (at most 1 per type per harvest). Cooking the parents or the newborn is forbidden during this phase.

description.zh: 每种动物符合条件得 1 只新生。
description.en: Gain 1 newborn per eligible animal type.

description.zh: 终局阶段：第 14 回合及其最终收获全部结束后进入（<round_14_completed>）——先结算<final_scoring>，再按<most_points_wins>判定胜者。
description.en: Endgame phase: entered after round 14 and its final harvest are complete (<round_14_completed>) — first resolve <final_scoring>, then adjudicate the winner by <most_points_wins>.

description.zh: 每位玩家用<scoring_pad>结算<final_scoring>：田地、牧场、谷物、蔬菜、羊、野猪、牛按数量表；每个未使用农场格 -1；每个围起来的马厩 +1；泥房间 +1/间、石房间 +2/间（木房间 0 分）；每个家庭成员 +3；每个乞讨标记 -3；改良卡按卡面。
description.en: Each player resolves <final_scoring> on the <scoring_pad>: fields, pastures, grain, vegetables, sheep, wild boar, and cattle by the quantity tables; -1 per unused farmyard space; +1 per fenced stable; +1 per clay room and +2 per stone room (wooden rooms 0); +3 per family member; -3 per begging marker; improvements by their printed points.

description.zh: 按计分表逐项计分并汇总<vp>。
description.en: Score each category and total the <vp>.

note.zh: 供应+田上+自称田的卡全算
note.en: supply + fields + cards identifying as fields all count

note.zh: 卡上动物除非另有说明也算
note.en: animals on cards count unless stated otherwise

rule.zh: 按卡面分数与奖励条件
按卡面分数与奖励条件

description.zh: 按<most_points_wins>判定胜者：总<vp>最高者获胜；平手时个人供应中建材（木头+黏土+芦苇+石头）更多者获胜（<most_building_resources_left>）；仍平手则并列分享名次。
description.en: Adjudicate the winner by <most_points_wins>: highest total <vp> wins; ties are broken by more building resources (wood + clay + reed + stone) in the personal supply (<most_building_resources_left>); if still tied, the players share the rank.

description.zh: 按顺序应用<most_points_wins>的两条标准筛选胜者。
description.en: Apply <most_points_wins>'s two criteria in order to select the winner.

rules.zh: 按<most_points_wins>判定胜者：先比较总<vp>（<most_points>），并列者比较<personal_supply>中建材数量（<most_building_resources_left>），仍并列则分享名次。
rules.en: Adjudicate by <most_points_wins>: compare total <vp> (<most_points>), then building resources in the <personal_supply> among ties (<most_building_resources_left>), then share the rank if still tied.
